findings.rationale: Clôture financière is defined without implying expenditure or completion; décaissement remains actual release of money. Passif éventuel retains dependence on a future event; engagements contractuels preserves covenants. Revised the comparison question to retain the quantity of accepted service or delivered assets, not merely which installation was delivered. Portefeuille de projets does not imply completed investment or available housing.

Cierre financiero, desembolso, pasivo contingente and cláusulas contractuales retain the financial-stage distinctions. Cartera de proyectos remains a pipeline rather than an operating portfolio. Revised the comparison question to preserve the quantity denominator for service or delivered assets. Exposición fiscal remains separate from private returns and no investment recommendation is added.
